title: Quantum Algorithms for Approximate Graph Isomorphism Testing
summary: The graph isomorphism problem asks whether two graphs are identical up to vertex relabeling. While the exact problem admits quasi-polynomial-time classical algorithms, many applications in molecular comparison, noisy network analysis, and pattern recognition require a flexible notion of structural similarity. We study the quantum query complexity of approximate graph isomorphism testing, where two graphs on $n$ vertices drawn from the Erdős--Rényi distribution $\mathcal{G} (n,1/2)$ are considered approximately isomorphic if they can be made isomorphic by at most $k$ edge edits.
